text:
incident-bot: Pager: high 5xx rate observed on hosted inference route /v1/generate for model rwd-chat-v3 (canary). Error rate spike ~12% over baseline. Dash: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/ingest/12345?panel=err_rate Alerting on-call.

alex: oncall here — ack. I'll start triage. What customers affected?

ricardo: CS: got two support tickets from Acme and Plurality reporting timeouts/500s. Ticket links (internal): https://support.redwood/acme/INC-8791 , https://support.redwood/plurality/INC-8792

maya: ML: quick diff on canary variant rwd-chat-v3-q8 shows error_rate_canary=0.118 vs baseline=0.012 over last 10k requests. p95 latency +180ms. Pasting small log excerpt.

maya: ```
[2026-03-11T21:02:03Z] request_id=abc123 model=rwd-chat-v3-q8 token_error=kv_cache_miss
[2026-03-11T21:02:04Z] request_id=def456 model=rwd-chat-v3-q8 generation=failed status=500 trace=oom
[2026-03-11T21:02:05Z] request_id=ghi789 model=rwd-chat-v3-q8 gpu_mem_peak=94% warn=kv_cache_eviction
```

jonas: infra: seeing GPU worker restarts on canary nodes, memory pressure correlates. Autoscaler spun up extra nodes but some pods evicted due to OOM. Node logs show memory fragmentation pattern on q8 kernels.

emilia: ops: customer impact estimate: ~21:01–21:07 UTC (~6m). ~1.2% of total requests but concentrated on revenue-sensitive customers (Acme). Recommend rollback if >1% revenue-sensitive or >2 key customers impacted.

sam: product: agree. If Acme is hit, escalate. What's our safe rollback plan? Can we pin back to v20260303?

maya: ML: previous canary variant rwd-chat-v3-q4 (tag v20260303) had no errors in the window. Pin check commands: 

maya: ```bash
redwood model pin --org=acme --model=rwd-chat-v3 --version=v20260303 --scope=canary
redwood rollout status --model rwd-chat-v3
```

alex: I'll run pin + rollback for canary only and post progress here.

alex: rollback command -> ```bash
redwood rollout rollback --model=rwd-chat-v3 --target=canary --to-version=v20260303 --reason="canary error spike 2026-03-11"
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollback rwd-chat-v3 canary -> v20260303 (initiated by alex). Image pull and pod restart in progress. ETA ~90s.

maya: while rollback runs, collecting timeline + logs for RCA. Starting a short timeline here.

maya: Timeline notes:
- 21:00:45 UTC: canary rollout started (rwd-chat-v3-q8)
- 21:01:20 UTC: first spike in 5xxs seen on dashboard
- 21:02:30 UTC: autoscaler added 2 nodes (reactive)
- 21:03:15 UTC: worker restarts observed on 2 nodes
- 21:04:00 UTC: error rate peaks around 12%
- 21:05:10 UTC: rollback initiated (alex)

alex: deploy-bot: rollback complete. Healthcheck: canary error_rate=0.009, p95 latency back to baseline. Confirming pin applied.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: rwd-chat-v3 canary pinned to v20260303. All canary pods: 6/6 ready.

ricardo: CS: contacted Acme; they reported failures reduced after ~21:06 UTC. I'll follow up and attach support ticket updates to the RCA.

sam: product: good. For RCA let's capture root hypotheses: (a) memory fragmentation/regression in q8 runtime kernels, (b) quantization kernel bug/regression in new canary build, (c) prompt-specific edge-case causing unexpected cache behavior. Need ML + infra repro.

maya: I'll open the RCA doc and paste diffs/logs; link draft: https://redwood.internal/rca/2625009876 (updating). Action items: reproduce locally with rwd-chat-v3-q8 + mem profiler, run kernel regression tests, add canary pin checks to rollout checklist.

alex: handing off oncall to next oncall (jonas) in 15m. Adding follow-ups to the oncall ticket and scheduling a 1hr post-incident sync.

jonas: taking handoff. I'll keep watch for regressions overnight and coordinate ML repro. Ping me if there are new customer hits.

emilia: ops: I'll draft customer-facing incident note and tag legal for regulated accounts.

maya: quick infra check note — confirm reserved/dedicated clusters did not get the canary (run: `redwood infra list-deployments --filter=reserved --model=rwd-chat-v3`).

alex: confirmed: reserved clusters still on v20260228, no cross-tenant auto-promotion.

ricardo: CS: closing loop with Acme; attaching support ticket numbers to RCA.

alex: closing thread; will update RCA link when the doc is ready. :white_check_mark:
